adultAssist.en-GB: An adult handles the hob, hot saucepan and sharp knife, and supervises cooling and assembly. Children rinse rice, mix cooled ingredients and roll with supervision.

safety.en-GB: Adults handle boiling water, hot rice and knives. Cool rice quickly in a clean shallow tray; keep refrigerated if not using at once, assemble just before serving, and refrigerate leftovers promptly. Do not leave cooked rice at room temperature.

nutrition.basis: Approximate calculation from weighed recipe quantities and generic USDA FDC ingredient references; rice dry weight is used before cooking; nori sheet mass and product nutrient values vary. Rounded per portion; not a laboratory analysis.
nutrition.method: Scale FoodData Central per-100-g reference nutrient values by ingredient weights, sum recipe totals, divide by 4 portions; 1 mL vinegar treated approximately as 1 g.

nutrition.basis: Approximate calculation from weighed recipe quantities and generic USDA FDC ingredient references; rice dry weight is used before cooking; nori sheet mass and product nutrient values vary. Rounded per portion; not a laboratory analysis.
nutrition.method: Scale FoodData Central per-100-g reference nutrient values by ingredient weights, sum recipe totals, divide by 4 portions; 1 mL vinegar treated approximately as 1 g.
